resultCodes.description: The public-safe handoff source and package satisfy all deterministic validation gates.
A restricted evidence id is present as a no-payload reference and remains public-safe.
The package routes an external prerequisite and does not claim it is complete.
A required Hush technical proof or package ref is missing.
A required responsibility domain, owner, visibility, evidence ref, non-claim boundary, missing-input behavior, or claim-effect field is missing or invalid.
A required non-claim boundary category, forbidden claim, allowed public wording, or blocking result code is missing or invalid.
The package claims Hush authority beyond technical proof packaging.
A customer checklist answer or customer-specific governance payload appears in public output.
The package claims to make or validate customer governance decisions.
The package claims an external prerequisite is complete or accepted.
The package claims public or state election readiness is resolved.
The package claims external auditor acceptance.
External auditor notes appear in public output.
The package directly mutates or authorizes mutation of the readiness register.
The package claims production rollout approval.
The package claims legal sufficiency or legal advice.
The package claims AGM management completion.
The package claims certification.
Restricted customer, legal, governance, voter, trustee, credential, private-path, or reviewer material appears in public output.
The package proposes anything other than RDY-DIM-010 8 -> 9.
A required upstream feature ref is stale, blocked, superseded, missing, or unknown.
